free_tier.stated: 100 GB of permanently free Drive capacity per organization by default; 8 GB max per uploaded file

retention.stated: 100 GB of permanently free Drive capacity per organization by default; 8 GB max per uploaded file | 8 GB per file (upload); 20 MB per file for 'import' to online docs; only pdf/office/zip/image/AV media preview - other binaries upload fine but get no preview; attachments inside online docs count toward quota since 2023-07-30

egress.terms: No egress line item; files are served from DingTalk's own CDN/OSS, share links only

tooling: Official OpenAPI (api.dingtalk.com, media upload + drive) plus the first-party CLI DingTalk-Real-AI/dingtalk-workspace-cli (3,766 stars, pushed 2026-10-21) exposing `dws drive upload|download|list|stats`
chaining: 100 GB x N free organizations. The grant is per organization, not per account, so N orgs is linear; also supports org-internal knowledge bases so a single org can be subdivided without extra accounts.

limits.value: review - other binaries upload fine but get no preview

limits_note: 8 GB per file (upload); 20 MB per file for 'import' to online docs; only pdf/office/zip/image/AV media preview - other binaries upload fine but get no preview; attachments inside online docs count toward quota since 2023-07-30
reliability_note: Quota accounting changed in 2023 to count in-document attachments, so a previously-fine account can silently blow its 100 GB; CLI is brand new (same-day commits) and unversioned.

evidence.proved: 'DingTalk grants every organization 100 GB of permanently free Drive capacity by default. If this is insufficient, the organization can purchase additional capacity.'
